To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

moderate alcohol intake (up to 30 grams per day) is associated with a lower risk of cardiovascular disease, and that the beneficial effects of alcohol on cardiovascular disease risk are not due to alcohol's ability to lower blood pressure.
Moderate restriction of alcohol intake in treated hypertensive subjects is associated with a significant fall in blood pressure that is independent of any effect of salt restriction.
Moderate restriction of dietary salt leads to a fall in blood pressure that is independent of any reduction in alcohol intake in treated hypertensive subjects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the effect of dietary salt restriction on blood pressure.
the development of a novel, non-invasive method to study the effect of a change in dietary salt intake on blood pressure.
the study of the relationship between alcohol and salt restriction and blood pressure in treated hypertension.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
moderate restriction of alcohol intake is an effective means of lowering blood pressure in treated hypertension.
the results of this study suggest that moderate restriction of alcohol intake in treated hypertensive subjects may lead to a fall in blood pressure.
a low sodium diet is beneficial in the treatment of essential hypertension.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of alcohol reduction and salt reduction was better than the sum of each alone, but not by a large amount.
the combination of alcohol reduction and sodium restriction is more effective for lowering blood pressure than either intervention alone.
the combination of alcohol and salt intake restriction in treated hypertensives is not additive in its blood pressure lowering effect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
alcohol is not the cause of hypertension in the majority of cases.
the best diet for the planet is also the best diet for you and for the rest of life on Earth.
the combination of alcohol and salt can lead to hypertension.
